findings.text: the Deliverable promises that a run whose launching host holds no running scheduler job "crew stop then records the exit", but _record_stopped_attempt_exit opens with `if record.get("launcher_host") not in (None, socket.gethostname()): return False` (reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py:2269) before any scheduler answer is consulted, so no change confined to reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py and reckon/crew/recovery_liveness.py can make crew stop record that exit; measured at HEAD 1edf1b0d: `_record_stopped_attempt_exit('r-test', {'launcher_host': 'other-node.example', ...})` returns False
